name: Voice quality (POLQA) per Operator and Campaign
description: Average listening quality of the completed calls and the share below 1.6.
query_sql:
SELECT Operator, Campaign,
  COUNT(POLQA_LQ_Avg) AS Samples,
  ROUND(AVG(POLQA_LQ_Avg), 2) AS Avg_POLQA,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(POLQA_LQ_Avg < 1.6) / COUNT(POLQA_LQ_Avg), 2) AS Below_1_6_Percent
FROM selected_voice
WHERE Call_Status = 'Completed' AND POLQA_LQ_Avg IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Operator, Campaign
ORDER BY Operator, Campaign
